dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you tell me more about this former Chairperson?

dialogues.speaker: Zavyalov
dialogues.text: His passing was a real loss. To me, he was a remarkably interesting old Domovoy.

dialogues.speaker: Zavyalov
dialogues.text: There are plenty of people in this world, but not many who manage to stay interesting into old age.
